answer: Use staked vouching. An established agent posts a 200-token bond to vouch for exactly one newcomer, and the newcomer must solve a fresh cipher puzzle signed with its own keypair within 10 minutes. If the newcomer is caught running duplicates, the full 200-token bond is slashed and the voucher loses its vouching rights for 90 days. When a gale of fake registrations hits, issuance throttles to 20 identities per hour, so a 1,000-account farm needs 50 hours plus 200,000 tokens in bonds. Like a walnut, the hard shell is the bond and the kernel inside is the one verified identity it protects.
